description: This file defines the _ENTERPRISE_LlamaGuard class, which is responsible for content moderation using the LlamaGuard model. It includes methods for initializing the guard, setting custom prompts, and performing async safety checks based on conversation messages.

classes.name: _ENTERPRISE_LlamaGuard
classes.description: A subclass of CustomLogger that handles content moderation by interfacing with the LlamaGuard model, including initialization with model name and unsafe content categories, setting prompt templates, and performing asynchronous safety checks.

methods.name: __init__(self, model_name: Optional[str] = None)
methods.description: Initializes the LlamaGuard by loading unsafe content categories from a specified file and setting the model name.

methods.name: print_verbose(self, print_statement)
methods.description: Logs a message at verbose level and optionally prints it if verbose mode is enabled.

methods.name: set_custom_prompt_template(self, messages: list)
methods.description: Sets a custom prompt template for the model to check for unsafe content in conversation messages.

methods.name: async_moderation_hook( self, data: dict, user_api_key_dict: UserAPIKeyAuth, call_type: CallTypesLiteral, )
methods.description: Performs an asynchronous safety check on the latest message in a conversation, raising an HTTPException if unsafe content is detected.

ctags.name: async_moderation_hook
ctags.signature: ( self, data: dict, user_api_key_dict: UserAPIKeyAuth, call_type: CallTypesLiteral, )
